title: Career Explorer config
description: Editor-supplied configuration for the career-explorer widget. The widget renders no bundled dataset: `endpoint` is required and everything it displays comes from that response.

endpoint.description: Same-origin path to the alumni JSON route served by the cbey_airtable module. Deliberately configuration rather than a constant in the bundle, so the widget can be pointed at a fixture and a route change needs no rebuild. Must be a root-relative path — an absolute URL would take the widget off-origin.

title.description: Overrides the masthead heading. Leave unset for "Yale Social Impact · Career Explorer".

intro.description: Overrides the lead sentence of the standfirst. The live alumni count and the "across N career paths" clause that follow it are generated from the data and are not editable.

lastUpdated.description: Overrides the "Last updated …" line. Leave unset to show the date of the last successful Airtable sync; set to an empty string to hide the line entirely.
